description: This file defines a custom ListView called DynamicListView that supports drag-and-drop reordering of its items through touch interactions, including bitmap handling for hover states, cell swapping, and auto-scrolling during dragging. It includes methods for creating hover representations, managing touch events, and updating visual states, along with an internal adapter reference for ID-based item lookup.

classes.name: DynamicListView
classes.description: A custom ListView supporting drag-and-drop item reordering with visual overlay and auto-scrolling during drag operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the list view, sets up listeners, and configures scroll amount based on device metrics.

methods.name: getAndAddHoverView
methods.description: Creates a bitmap drawable overlay of the selected list item for dragging visualization.

methods.name: getBitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Adds a border overlay to a view's bitmap for visual emphasis during drag.

methods.name: getBitmapFromView
methods.description: Generates a bitmap snapshot of a given view.

methods.name: updateNeighborViewsForID
methods.description: Updates references to views directly above and below the current item being dragged.

methods.name: getViewForID
methods.description: Retrieves a list item view by its item ID.

methods.name: getPositionForID
methods.description: Maps an item ID to its position index in the list.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Draws the hover overlay on top of the list items during drag.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch interactions for dragging, including move, up, cancel, and multitouch events.

methods.name: handleCellSwitch
methods.description: Determines whether to swap list items based on drag position, updates dataset and visual state.

methods.name: swapElements
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the data list.

methods.name: touchEventsEnded
methods.description: Finalizes dragging, animates the hover cell into its final position, and resets state.

methods.name: touchEventsCancelled
methods.description: Resets drag state when a drag operation is cancelled.

methods.name: handleMobileCellScroll
methods.description: Handles auto-scrolling when the dragged item reaches the list edge.

methods.name: isScrollCompleted
methods.description: Checks if scrolling has finished and finalizes drag operation if needed.

methods.name: checkAndHandleFirstVisibleCellChange
methods.description: Detects upward list scroll to handle cell swapping.

methods.name: checkAndHandleLastVisibleCellChange
methods.description: Detects downward list scroll to handle cell swapping.
